Record Class PyprojectModel.Validation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.model.PyprojectModel.Validation
Record Components:
enabled - whether validation is enabled globally
failOnNotPresent - fail when expected config/classpath entries are missing
deduceEnvironments - infer environments from runtime context
validateDependencyInjection - enable dependency-injection validation
dependencyInjectionValidationStrategy - dependency-injection validation strategy
format - report format (json/html/both)
suppressions - warning/error suppression patterns
suppressInjectErrors - dependency-injection error suppressions
projectBaseDir - project base directory for path normalization
resourcesDirs - default resources directories for validation
run - run scenario validation settings
test - test scenario validation settings
production - production scenario validation settings
